_comment: Works as-is against the compose.yml in this repo - setup.sh writes the two values it needs (RCON_PASSWORD, BUILDER) into .env, and ${VAR} references here are resolved from the environment. Copy to rcon-servers.json only if you need more than one server or want to hand-edit. `allow` is REQUIRED: RCON is console-level, so anyone on that list can /fill anything - an unset BUILDER leaves it empty and the bot refuses every builder rather than opening the console to the world. `operators` may remove other people's builds (defaults to the first allow entry). `log` and the world dir are paths INSIDE the bot container - see compose.yml. `readVersion` is the minecraft-data registry used to read schematics (see src/version.js).
